$comment: 자주 오는 차량 1 — the tile button (`uiComponent: "button"` on a boolean is the one interactive control Homey allows on a tile). Five of these are declared up front because Homey has NO dynamic-capability declaration; each device adds and removes them at runtime so a lot with two favourites shows exactly two buttons. The label a user actually sees is NOT this title: it is overwritten per device with set_capability_options("iparking_quick_1", {"title": …}) so the tile reads [엄마차 방문 등록]. This title is the fallback for the moment before that call lands and for a runtime that exposes no options setter at all. `getable` is true — unlike Homey's own `button` capability — because the press has to be un-latched afterwards (set back to false) or the button can only ever be pressed once. NO `insights`: a momentary button is not a measurement. See iparking_lib/const.py's MAX_FAVORITES / quick_capability().
